summary: Iteration 345 - Performance Optimizations Verification. All 26 backend tests PASSED. Verified: (1) News feed 15s TTL cache with per-user/filter scoping, (2) Cost-centers and accounts 30s TTL global cache with CRUD invalidation, (3) Calendar events and resource bookings return correct data after index changes, (4) Backend running with 8 uvicorn workers.

news_feed_cache.description: GET /api/news/feed returns valid JSON {posts, total, page, pages}. Repeated calls within 15s are fast (cache hit: 2ms vs cold: 8-9ms). Different page/sort/category/priority params use separate cache slots. Search queries bypass cache (always hit DB).

news_feed_invalidation.description: POST /api/news/posts followed by GET /api/news/feed shows newly published post immediately (cache invalidated on create).

cost_centers_cache.description: GET /api/cost-centers returns list. Two rapid calls are fast (cache hit). POST/PUT/DELETE operations invalidate cache - subsequent GET shows changes immediately.

accounts_cache.description: GET /api/accounts returns list. Two rapid calls are fast. POST invalidates cache - new account visible immediately.

calendar_and_bookings.description: GET /api/calendar/events returns events array. GET /api/resource-bookings returns full data with all expected fields (booking_id, resource_id, user_id, start_at, end_at, status). No fields missing due to index changes.

load_endpoints_sanity.description: All endpoints from loadtest.py READ_ENDPOINTS work correctly: dashboard_stats, tasks_list, notifications, resources_list, chat_conversations, chat_unread, user_permissions, catering_items.

backend_health.description: Health endpoint returns ok with mongo check passing. Auth login works correctly. Backend running with 8 uvicorn workers (verified via ps aux).

performance_observations.workers: 8 uvicorn workers running with uvloop + httptools
performance_observations.indexes_verified: Compound indexes on bookings(host_id, status), bookings.meeting_id, invoice_master_data(type, active, code), invoice_master_data.item_id created at startup

critical_code_review_comments: TTL cache implementation in news_feed.py is correct - 15s TTL, per-user/filter scoping, search bypasses cache
Master data cache in master_data.py is correct - 30s TTL, global slot, invalidation on all CRUD operations
MongoDB indexes in server.py lines 200-206 correctly create compound indexes for performance hotspots
start.sh correctly sets 8 workers with uvloop/httptools for production mode
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test cost centers, accounts, and news posts during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 345 performance optimizations verified. All caches working correctly with proper invalidation. Backend running with 8 workers. No regressions found in calendar/bookings endpoints after index changes. The perf report from iter 344 soak test is at /app/test_reports/perf_iter344/REPORT.md showing p95 improvements of 16-30% across hotspot endpoints.
